create_ohem_sampler: create an OHEMPixelSampler instance with a decode head context and threshold for hard example mining
sample_hard_pixels: sample pixels with high loss or low prediction confidence using the OHEMPixelSampler sample method
configure_threshold_sampling: configure OHEMPixelSampler with a threshold value to select low-confidence predictions for mining
configure_min_kept_sampling: configure OHEMPixelSampler with min_kept to keep top loss pixels when no threshold is set
review_ohem_sampler: review the OHEMPixelSampler class and its sample method for online hard example mining in segmentation
